plans.idea: Left-aligned editorial column: badge logo top-left, then a large headline and subheadline, the FREE/LIMITED SPOTS chips, and the CTA all on one shared left edge, reading top to bottom.

Two-column split that keeps the original banner's logic: the round logo sits large on the left, vertically centred, and a right column stacks the headline, subheadline, chips and CTA on one left edge.
Header, message, footer: a header row with the logo top-left and the chips across from it, a full-width headline block in the middle, and the CTA anchored bottom-left so the eye ends on the action.
